facts.headline: Berachain Bearish? Social Sentiment Souring
facts.summary: Berachain's rise was driven by excitement over its Proof-of-Liquidity design and a tight, meme-driven community. But skepticism is mounting over its tokenomics, insider allocations, and whether vibes can substitute for fundamentals as $BERA drills lower after launch.
